job.job_description:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with around 2-6 years of hands-on experience to join a fast-growing product / service-based company. You'll work on real production features, collaborate with experienced engineers, and take ownership of end-to-end development.

This role is ideal for developers who want strong learning, stability, and growth rather than just maintenance work.




Key Responsibilities



Develop and maintain scalable web applications across frontend and backend

Build clean, reusable UI components and REST APIs

Work closely with product and design teams to implement features end-to-end

Optimize application performance, security, and reliability

Debug, test, and improve existing codebases

Participate in code reviews and technical discussions


Tech Stack (Any combination is fine)



Frontend: React.js / Angular / Vue.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript

Backend: Node.js / Java / Python / PHP

Databases: MongoDB / MySQL / PostgreSQL

Tools & Concepts: Git, REST APIs, basic system design, authentication


You do not need expertise in everything strong fundamentals matter more than tools.


What Were Looking For



2-5 years of real-world development experience

Solid understanding of frontend + backend fundamentals

Ability to build features independently with minimal supervision

Good problem-solving and debugging skills

Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies


Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)



Experience with cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure)

Exposure to Docker, CI/CD, or basic DevOps

Experience working on live production systems


What Youll Get



Competitive salary: 3.5 – 8.5 LPA (based on skills & interview performance)

Opportunity to work on real-world products

Career growth with exposure to modern tech stacks

Supportive engineering culture and mentorship
